cards.name: Bar chart grow (shape layers)
cards.summary: Five vertical bars grow from a baseline one after another, each with a value label that rides the bar top and counts up to its value.
use_for: comparisons of 3-8 values in a news explainer
avoid: more than about 8 bars (labels collide at this size)
values with very different magnitudes on one axis
labels in Devanagari through the counter (it only formats Latin digits and the suffix)
cards.keyframes_note: Scenes for vfx.render_scenes(scenes, aep, out_dir) at its defaults (1920x1080, 25 fps); segs are [t0, v0, t1, v1, ease] in comp seconds with ease lin | smooth | out | in (ae_lib.jsx seg). Data -> geometry: baseline y 880, 6 px per unit (100 = 600 px), bar width 120 at x = 600 + 180*i; each bar is a shape layer whose origin is its bottom centre, so a scale seg [100, 0] -> [100, 100] grows it upward; bars start 0.15 s apart (stagger) with ease 'out'. Value labels are 'counter' layers (Source Text expression easeOut(time, c0, c1, from, to), thousands commas on) moving with the bar top. To re-target, change vals/labels and recompute h = 6*v and the counter's end position y = 844 - h.

verified.note: Five bars grow one after another from the baseline (A and B first, E last, by 2 s) with value labels riding the bar tops and counting up to 42/67/55/81/30%.

cards.name: Line chart draw-on
cards.summary: A data line draws itself across a gridded plot with Trim Paths while a dot pops on at each data point as the line reaches it, ending on a counter for the last value.
use_for: showing a rise or fall in one sweep
avoid: more than about 3 lines on one chart
noisy daily data (resample to weekly first)
cards.keyframes_note: Scenes for vfx.render_scenes(scenes, aep, out_dir) at its defaults (1920x1080, 25 fps); segs are [t0, v0, t1, v1, ease] in comp seconds with ease lin | smooth | out | in (ae_lib.jsx seg). Plot area x 420..1500, y 880 (0) .. 280 (100), 6 px per unit; the line is one open shape path with Trim Paths End 0 -> 100 over 2 s, LINEAR so that the dot times can be computed: a dot appears at 0.5 + 2.0 * (path length up to its point / total length), which this scene pre-computes. Strokes get round joins and caps (vfx_build.jsx). Grid lines are 1 px at 22% layer opacity.

verified.note: The line draws across the gridded plot, a dot pops at each point as the line reaches it, and the last value's counter (72) appears at the end.

cards.name: Donut chart segments
cards.summary: Three coloured ring segments draw on in turn around a grey track, with the first segment's percentage counting up in the centre.
use_for: a single headline share with context
avoid: segments under about 4% (the round caps swallow them)
cards.keyframes_note: Scenes for vfx.render_scenes(scenes, aep, out_dir) at its defaults (1920x1080, 25 fps); segs are [t0, v0, t1, v1, ease] in comp seconds with ease lin | smooth | out | in (ae_lib.jsx seg). One 72-vertex closed circle path (radius 220, clockwise from 12 o'clock) per segment; Trim Paths Start is held at the segment's start and End animates from start to end (percent of the circumference). Strokes get ROUND caps in vfx_build.jsx, each reaching width/2 = 28 px (about 2% of the circumference) past its end, so every segment is shortened by 2.5% at each end to leave a small visible gap. Measured 2026-10-13: the 30 px caption under the number must stay inside the ring's 384 px hole (about 20 characters); the placeholder '<LABEL OF THE FIRST SEGMENT>' runs under the ring: shorten it or move it below the ring.

verified.note: Three segments draw on in turn around the grey track while the centre counts 0 -> 45%; the placeholder caption is wider than the ring's hole and runs under the ring on both sides.

cards.name: Pie chart slices pop
cards.summary: Filled pie wedges computed from the data pop in one after another from the centre, each with its percentage outside the rim.
use_for: simple shares (2-5 parts) for general audiences
cards.keyframes_note: Scenes for vfx.render_scenes(scenes, aep, out_dir) at its defaults (1920x1080, 25 fps); segs are [t0, v0, t1, v1, ease] in comp seconds with ease lin | smooth | out | in (ae_lib.jsx seg). Each slice is a closed polygon [centre, arc points every <=3 degrees], filled, origin at the pie centre so the scale pop grows it from the middle. A Trim Paths wedge (stroke width = radius) is NOT used: vfx_build.jsx gives every stroke round caps, which bulge past the wedge edges. Labels sit at 1.3x the radius on each slice's mid-angle.

verified.note: Blue, orange and pink wedges pop in one after another from the centre and each gets its percentage outside the rim.

cards.name: Percentage ring with counter
cards.summary: A ring fills clockwise to a percentage while the number counts up in its centre and a caption fades in.
use_for: a KPI card in a reel
avoid: showing several rates at once (use bars)
cards.keyframes_note: Scenes for vfx.render_scenes(scenes, aep, out_dir) at its defaults (1920x1080, 25 fps); segs are [t0, v0, t1, v1, ease] in comp seconds with ease lin | smooth | out | in (ae_lib.jsx seg). Track ring and progress ring share one 72-vertex circle path; the progress ring's Trim Paths End goes 0 -> 78 with ease 'out' in sync with the counter (same c0/c1). Change both '78's to re-target.

verified.note: The ring fills clockwise to 78% while the number counts up in the centre and the caption fades in under it.

cards.name: Progress bar fill
cards.summary: A horizontal bar fills from the left to a percentage with a counter below it.
use_for: progress towards a target (funds, construction, vaccination)
avoid: exact readings: the bar is a 1000 px track, so 1 px = 0.1%
cards.keyframes_note: Scenes for vfx.render_scenes(scenes, aep, out_dir) at its defaults (1920x1080, 25 fps); segs are [t0, v0, t1, v1, ease] in comp seconds with ease lin | smooth | out | in (ae_lib.jsx seg). The fill rectangle's origin is its left end ([460, 540]), so scaling x from 0 to 64 grows it to the right; the counter shares the timing. Corners are square (shape paths here have no roundness).

verified.note: The bar fills from the left to 64% while the counter below it counts up.

cards.name: Timeline bar with milestones
cards.summary: A line draws left to right and a milestone dot, year and event label pop on each time the line reaches them.
avoid: more than about 7 milestones on one line (labels collide)
events packed close together in time
cards.keyframes_note: Scenes for vfx.render_scenes(scenes, aep, out_dir) at its defaults (1920x1080, 25 fps); segs are [t0, v0, t1, v1, ease] in comp seconds with ease lin | smooth | out | in (ae_lib.jsx seg). Milestones are fractions of the line (0 .. 1); with a LINEAR trim over 3 s each one appears at 0.3 + 3*f. Years sit above, event labels below; replace the <...> placeholders.

verified.note: The line draws left to right and each milestone dot, year and event label pops on as the line reaches it.

cards.name: Highlighter and underline on a key line
cards.summary: A marker-yellow highlight sweeps behind a line of text, then a red underline draws under it: the 'this is the sentence that matters' beat.
use_for: the key line of a statement or report
avoid: highlighting more than one or two lines at once
placing it over a face (house rule)
cards.keyframes_note: Scenes for vfx.render_scenes(scenes, aep, out_dir) at its defaults (1920x1080, 25 fps); segs are [t0, v0, t1, v1, ease] in comp seconds with ease lin | smooth | out | in (ae_lib.jsx seg). The highlight is a 70 px stroke behind the text (so live text stays crisp); over a screenshot use the same stroke with blend MULTIPLY on top instead ('Screenshot zoom with highlighter'). Its ends (560..1360) are placeholders: match them to the text's width (sourceRectAtTime) for the real copy.

verified.note: The yellow highlight sweeps behind the line, then the red underline draws under it; with the placeholder end points the bar covers the line only from its third to its third-last character, as the keyframes note warns.
